source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of types of testing (PDF 63).

items: Unit testing: code ke chhote hisse (jaise functions ya classes) alag alag test karna. Python ka unittest module is ke liye aam hai.
Integration testing: dekhna ke code ke mukhtalif hisse mil kar theek kaam karte hain.
Functional testing: user ki nazar se dekhna ke software tawaqqo ke mutabiq chalta hai.
Regression testing: yaqeen karna ke nayi tabdeeliyon ne pehle se chalta kaam kharab nahi kiya. Misaal: neeche unittest module se add function test kiya gaya hai, mukhtalif inputs de kar.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yeh code bina indentation ke chhapti hai: def test_add class ke andar, assertEqual wali lines def ke andar, aur unittest.main() if ke andar indented honi chahiyein (warna IndentationError). '__main__' ke quotes bhi tirchhe (’ ’) chhape hain; seedhe quotes chahiyein.

Wazahat: yeh code add function ka unit test hai. TestMathOperations class assertEqual se check karti hai ke add(2, 3) = 5 aur add(-1, 1) = 0 ho. Dono theek hon to test pass (OK); warna test fail ho kar farq batata hai.

blocks.explanation: Ke add(2, 3) bilkul 5 lautaye; warna test fail ho kar farq batata hai.
